measurement.panel_rule: chr21 genes with RNA detection in >=1% of cells plus descending label-free normalized-dispersion selection until the transfer estimate reaches the 3.5e9 byte budget or 1500 genes; gene body +/-2000bp flank, clipped at 0, canonical chr1-22/X, BED zero-based half-open

read_window_deviation.reason: at window=262144 the actual transfer estimate (3493593088) left only 0.18% headroom and the run exceeded the 3.5e9 byte budget on per-chunk window rounding and transport retries; at window=131072 the offline estimate is 2027028480 (~42% headroom)
read_window_deviation.counts_invariance: the fragment reader filters parsed records by chunk coffset/uoffset, so record counts are independent of the read window; only transfer cost changes

notes: Fixed label-free panel; no cell-type deconvolution. All 548 regions yielded complete joins against the fragment index; 2 regions had no overlapping fragments (empty). The acceptance decision is a real-paired input-integrity decision only; it makes no biological claim about the panel.
